name: parts
assumes: two placed instances in a Cadence design carry the same reference designator; the first is already a part
package compares the instances' source packages case-insensitively, ignoring a trailing _<n> (PAD_1x9 and PAD_1X9_2 are the same)
part_number compares the part-number properties: one_missing means one instance records none
section new means the second instance draws a section the part has not drawn; repeat means one it already has
wiring compares pins the two copies share: agree means the same net, nc_vs_net means one copy leaves the pin unconnected and the other wires it, conflict means two different real nets
